basics.name: Kevin Rúa González
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer with a mindset focused on technical excellence. I specialize in designing clean architectures and developing end-to-end platforms, ranging from interactive interfaces to backend services and automation systems. I excel at transforming complex requirements into maintainable software and staying committed to continuous professional growth and learning.

work.name: Centro de Inmunología Molecular (CIM)
work.summary: Full stack development of a multi-tenant platform for managing, prioritizing and measuring the impact of science and innovation initiatives.
responsibilities: Develop the platform's frontend and backend across the full initiative lifecycle: calls, review, execution and prioritization.
Implement the multi-tenant architecture, two-factor authentication (2FA) and role-based permissions, keeping each organization's data isolated.
Build the data layer and deployment infrastructure with PostgreSQL, S3/MinIO file storage and Docker containers.

work.name: AICA Pharmaceutical Laboratories
work.summary: Development and implementation of an intelligent demand forecasting system for pharmaceuticals using Machine Learning and process automation.
responsibilities: Designed and implemented data analysis workflows and trained Machine Learning models in KNIME based on historical pharmaceutical data.
Developed a REST API to manage trained ML models and expose KNIME analytical workflows as web services.
Integrated n8n automation workflows connected to Telegram API to enable messaging-based access and remote queries to system services.

education.institution: José Antonio Echeverría Technological University of Havana (CUJAE)

projects.name: E-Shop
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce platform for electronics: product catalog with search and category filters, persistent shopping cart, orders with delivery status, and an admin panel to manage products and orders.
highlights: Product catalog with search and category filtering
Persistent shopping cart and order tracking with delivery status
Role-based authentication (JWT + HTTP-only cookies) with customer and admin areas
REST API documented with Swagger on a PostgreSQL + Prisma data model

projects.name: Events Decoration Manager
projects.description: Full-stack application to manage event decoration contracts: clients, events, providers with products and services, and contracts with itemized resources and a modification history.
highlights: Contract management linking clients and events with products and services
Provider catalog with products and services per provider
Contract modification history and employee roles (staff, HR, accounting, CEO)
Role-based authentication (JWT) on a shadcn/ui (Radix) interface
